summary: Tested Marketplace Admin Dashboard + Buyer↔Seller Chat (iteration 4). 14/14 backend pytest tests passing. Frontend admin login, users/products/orders pages, buyer chat drawer (send + receive), /messages inbox, and non-admin redirect all working correctly.

issues: Product without image_url shows a small emoji-only placeholder in a large hero area; consider a neutral SVG placeholder for better polish
Sidebar user email overflows on very narrow admin sidebar (cosmetic only, no functional impact)

critical_code_review_comments: admin.py mp_admin_stats iterates paid_orders_cursor manually to count and sum revenue; could be replaced by a single aggregate pipeline for scalability (non-blocking).
chat.py mp_chat_threads unique index on (buyer_id, seller_id) is relied upon; ensure it is created at startup (seed.py / index bootstrap) to guarantee dedup under concurrency.

chat.py chat_messages endpoint marks unread=0 for the reader even when `after` filter returns [] (i.e. polling with no new msgs). Minor: causes unnecessary write on every poll. Consider only resetting when messages are actually delivered.

admin.py mp_admin_ban does not invalidate existing JWT tokens for banned users; a banned user with a still-valid token can access /mp/auth/me and non-login routes until expiry. Consider adding a banned-check to get_mp_user dependency.
admin.py mp_admin_delete_user cascades product deletion but does not clean up mp_chat_threads / mp_chat_messages tied to that user — orphan chat threads will linger.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created and deleted product '6aa427aac04c06567124f848' (TEST Produto Chat) for UI chat test. Chat threads/messages between chat.buyer and chat.seller remain in DB.
